title: Company Calendar and Public Holidays (Demo)
summary: Demo stub for RAG-Destroyer. Mentions annual leave policy window and company-wide holidays for keyword search testing.
content:
# Company Calendar (Demo)

This is **demo content** shipped with the repository so you can run GURU without importing a full vault.

- References **annual leave** booking rules and **public holidays**.
- Visible to any role that may access the **General** silo.

title: Branch Escalation Thresholds — Management Brief (Demo)
summary: Demo management-only brief on escalation approval bands and incident routing. Used to test YAML audience management vs staff.
content:
# Escalation Thresholds (Demo)

This file sets **`audience: management`** in front matter.

- **Operational Staff** should **not** see this document in previews or search results when RBAC simulation is enabled.
- **Department Head (VP)** and **C-suite** roles **should** see it within authorized silos.

Keywords: **escalation**, **approval**, routing for branch incidents.
